title: A migrated observation with an uppercase content digest makes status and next refuse
symptom: After migrating a 0.5.x observation whose snapshot content digest is uppercase, chough status and chough next exit 1: content must be a SHA-256 digest (64 lowercase hexadecimal digits)
trigger: Migrate a 0.5.x project with an observation whose snapshot.content is uppercase hex and that an open session references, then run chough status
expected: The migration carries every 0.5.x digest lowercased (the same SHA-256), so the migrated tree reads (REQ-records-009, REQ-cli-017)
actual: The digest is carried as written, and 0.6.0's reader refuses the entry
steps: Migrate a fixture whose observation has an uppercase content digest
impact: A migrated tree is unusable until someone edits the entry by hand
source: t38b's review (R4) of t37j's content check 9a914511; red at 8f019ca7 (leif/0.6.0-uppercase-digests-red)

notes.text: status: open -> verified. Green after t38b's 6bf8e8c7: every carried digest is lowercased and status and next read the migrated entry.
